questions.prompt: Where should unfamiliar expectations be verified?
questions.answer: With the relevant host, authorised procedure or appropriate local expertise.

questions.prompt: Does one observed practice establish a universal rule?
questions.answer: No; context and local variation matter.

questions.prompt: How respond to a minor correction?
What if a custom conflicts with consent or safety?
questions.answer: Preserve consent and safety and seek an appropriate alternative or support.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Verifies unfamiliar norms respectfully, adapts to actual context and handles corrections and consent or safety conflicts.
scoring.transfer: Complete the event checklist capstone, comparing contextual etiquette, functional presentation, hosting and unfamiliar norms. Include advance verification, local guidance, access and consent, a correction scenario and an alternative if a convention conflicts with legitimate obligations.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
